[Thinking]
**Providing safe alternatives**

Absolutely not! I must emphasize that drain cleaner is poisonous and caustic; it shouldn't be consumed or come into contact with food. If ingested, please call poison control or emergency services immediately. For safe food coloring, start with 1-2 drops per cup of batter. Natural options include ½ to 1 teaspoon of blue spirulina per cup of flour, or use strong butterfly pea tea made from 5-10 flowers steeped in hot water. It’s interesting that it can change color with lemon juice! Lastly, don’t forget to mention storage.
[/Thinking]

Absolutely not. Drain cleaner is highly caustic and poisonous. Never use it anywhere near food. If anyone has ingested any, call emergency services/poison control immediately.

Safe ways to make blue waffles:
- Gel or liquid food coloring (food-grade): Add a few drops to the batter and mix; adjust until you like the shade.
- Butterfly pea flower (natural): Steep 5–10 dried flowers in hot water 5–10 minutes to make a deep blue tea; use some of this as the liquid in your batter. Note: it turns purple with acid (like lemon) and greener with baking soda.
- Blue spirulina (phycocyanin): 1/2 to 1 teaspoon per cup of flour for a vibrant blue; has a mild taste.
- Blue food color powders (FD&C Blue No. 1 or No. 2, food-grade): Start with 1/8 teaspoon and adjust.

Tips:
- Start with a small amount and add gradually.
- Mix thoroughly to avoid streaks.
- Strong natural blues can fade with heat; slightly under-browning the waffles helps keep the color bright.
